   HOMŒOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA

         by William BOERICKE, M.D.

           FERRUM MAGNETICUM

         Loadstone


Marked symptoms in intestinal tract. Pain in nape of neck. Paralytic
        weakness. Small warts on hands.



Stomach.--  During a meal, flatulence; afterwards lassitude
        taciturn and hot, pain in epigastrium, especially on breathing.



Abdomen.--  Movements and grumbling in abdomen. Loose
        evacuations with much flatulency, especially left side with pullings in legs. Abundant and
        frequent emission of fetid flatus.



Dose.--  Third potency.
